title: Sebastian and the Thorn
author: Mara Halloran
blurb: Wren Brightwater, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
